title: MetalPipe Anvils
description: Adds the metal pipe sound when a anvil is placed or falling.
body:
## Replace the anvil sounds with Metal Pipe noises.
A simple and funny resource pack without any bloat and goes straight to the point.
Great resoruce pack to troll and jumpscare your friends.

**Sound from Pixabays royalty-free sound effect library.**

If you're having any isseus using the pack or not working for your version feel free to contact me thru my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/YvEzbQxkMx).
